sql: select e.key, ep.epoch_number, ep.started_at, ep.impact_class, (select min(lo.created_at) from live_orders lo where lo.created_at >= ep.started_at) as dummy from experiments e join experiment_versions v on v.experiment_id=e.id join experiment_epochs ep on ep.version_id=v.id where ep.ended_at is null and e.key in (mmsell-win-set,mmsell-price-ceiling-cell-size,mmsell-price-ceiling-size-split,mmsell-price-ceiling,mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity,mmsell-price-ceiling-contest-cap,liquidity-incentive-mm,mmsell-rain-season,mmsell-temperature-season,mmsell-weather-bands) order by ep.started_at
